# 🏗️ Initial Maven Project & CI/CD Setup (v0.0.0)

## 📋 Epic Overview
Establish the complete foundation for the Java Selenium Hybrid Automation Framework with Maven project structure, essential dependencies, and comprehensive CI/CD pipeline.

**Priority**: 🔴 High
**Estimate**: 3-5 days
**Target Branch**: `main` via `dev`

---

## 🎯 Business Objectives
- ✅ Create scalable automation framework foundation
- ✅ Enable efficient team collaboration through CI/CD
- ✅ Establish quality gates for all future development
- ✅ Provide robust testing infrastructure for demoqa.com automation

---

## 📝 Technical Requirements

### 1. Maven Project Structure
- [x] Initialize Maven project with proper POM structure
- [x] Configure Java 21 compatibility
- [x] Set up source directory layout (`src/main/java`, `src/test/java`)
- [x] Add `.gitignore` for Java/Maven patterns
- [x] Configure UTF-8 encoding

### 2. Core Dependencies
- [x] **Selenium WebDriver** `4.34.0` - Web automation
- [x] **TestNG** `7.11.0` - Testing framework
- [x] **WebDriverManager** `6.2.0` - Automated driver management
- [x] **Log4j2** `2.25.1` - Structured logging
- [x] **Allure TestNG** `2.29.1` - Advanced reporting

### 3. Maven Plugins
- [x] **Compiler Plugin** `3.14.0` - Java 21 compilation
- [x] **Surefire Plugin** `3.5.3` - Test execution
- [x] **Clean Plugin** `3.5.0` - Build cleanup
- [x] **Resources Plugin** `3.3.1` - Resource management
- [x] **Jar Plugin** `3.4.2` - Packaging
- [x] **Install Plugin** `3.1.4` - Local installation

### 4. CI/CD Pipeline (GitHub Actions)
- [x] **Main CI Pipeline** - Build, test, quality checks
- [x] **POM Validation** - XML validation + dependency checks
- [x] **Feature PR Checks** - Branch-specific validation
- [x] **Release Automation** - Semantic versioning + tagging
- [x] **Security Scanning** - Dependency vulnerability checks

### 5. Automation Scripts
- [x] **POM Validator** (v1.4) - HTML reports + dependency graphs
- [x] **Release PR Processor** - Automated release management
- [x] **Feature PR Processor** - Branch PR automation
- [x] **Milestone Manager** - GitHub milestone synchronization
- [x] **Issue Creator** - Bulk issue creation from templates

### 6. Documentation
- [x] **README.md** - Comprehensive project documentation
- [x] **CI Setup Guide** - Pipeline configuration details
- [x] **Roadmap** - Version milestones and timeline
- [x] **Contributing Guidelines** - Team development standards
